messages.author: carlos.galvan.101648@lakemail.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new members cohort for the Pacific Northwest chapter. Bruno here, glad to have you all on board as we get things started for this year.

messages.author: javier.mendez.102014@lakemail.example
messages.text: Glad to be here. Gunnar from Portland, working on quality management. Let me know if anyone needs help navigating the initial compliance checklists.

messages.author: daniel.quinby.101914@rimefieldcheesemonger.example
messages.text: Reid here from Seattle. I am mostly looking forward to the sessions on raw-milk aging rule updates and better traceability tools.

messages.author: maya.lin.102533@cindervalecreamery.example
messages.text: Maya from Boise. We are focusing on our sanitation logs this quarter, so any advice on streamlining documentation is very welcome.

messages.author: claire.houghton.102669@homestead.example
messages.text: Claire in Seattle. As a specialty buyer, I am always interested in hearing how everyone is managing supply costs and raw material sourcing this spring.

messages.author: carlos.galvan.101648@lakemail.example
messages.text: Thanks for the updates everyone. ICF staff let me know the mid-year chapter meet-up is coming together, so watch your inbox for details soon.

messages.author: javier.mendez.102014@lakemail.example
messages.text: We are also looking at some equipment upgrades for next-generation milk handling. If anyone has experience with the newer press systems, let me know.

messages.author: li.huang.102472@aspenholtcheesemaking.example
messages.text: Taylor here from Portland. We just finished our summer audit and the traceability software recommended by the chapter made a big difference.

messages.author: travis.hensley.102658@dapplewickcheeseco.example
messages.text: Travis in Boise. Glad to hear the audits went well Taylor, we are preparing for ours next month and reviewing our aging room humidity controls.

messages.author: carlos.galvan.101648@lakemail.example
messages.text: Great progress all around this year. Let us try to wrap up our first-year checklist items before the final regional meeting in November.
